title: Jerryd Bayless Contract Is Holding Up Philly From Pursuing Jamal Crawford Per League Source
htmlContent:
[caption id="attachment_500180" align="alignnone" width="895"] Photo Credit - Twitter[/caption] The reigning Rookie of the year Ben Simmons would like for the 76ers to sign 19-year veteran Jamal Crawford, but it is not going to be as easy as many may think. According to Brandon "Scoop B' Robinson league sources have expressed to him that in order for the Sixers to sign Crawford, Philly would need to move Jerryd Bayless' contract.  Bayless' contract can be moved in two different ways first he can be traded, which Philly hasn't been able to find a trade partner after talks with the Cavaliers has cooled off last month according to Keith Pompey of the Philadelphia Inquirer. The deal would have seen the Cavaliers send one-time Sixer Kyle Korver. The other scenario is to buy out his $8.57 million according to Spotrac. Bayless is in the final year of a three-year deal worth 27 million. We will keep you updated as this story continues to develop in Philly.

Source: Jamal Crawford to Sixers is a done deal IF the team can buy our or trade Jerryd Bayless. Bayless has one season left on his original three-year, $27 million deal, which comes with a cap hit of more than $8.57 million this season. - https://t.co/jREry0dv4z #Sixers pic.twitter.com/HTZKcAQtz6

— Brandon Robinson (@ScoopB) August 31, 2018
